assumption_for_conditional_arithmetic: Every contributing study has the active-label/nonempty-observation support needed for the full constant. Aggregate logs do not independently establish that count; numbers below are illustrative under this condition, not an additional measured dataset statistic.
decision: Withdraw the claim that small raw-density movement itself strengthens weak-learning evidence. Keep unchanged fixed-final scoring; original C24 gradient and regional-sensitivity measurements retain their stated early/two-case/nonencoder limitations. No clinical or final-checkpoint mechanism gain follows.
finding: The raw NLL is dominated by a fixed zero-gradient normalization constant; its small relative change is not evidence of stalled density learning.
source_decomposition: For each active label/context with unit variance: NLL/(N*64) = 0.5*log(2*pi) + sum_squared_negative_residual/(2*N*64) - q*logBF/(N*64). The constant cancels from the log Bayes factor. B has the same constant for each nonempty context plus half mean squared residual.
